name: Walker County, TX
findings: Walker County has 176 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Walker County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Walker County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Walker County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
